html:
G'oya

Ikkinchi eng arzon narx bu eng arzonidan qimmat narxlar ichidagi eng arzoni. Avval qabul qilingan takliflarning MIN ini topamiz, keyin undan katta summalarning MIN ini olamiz. Holat sharti ikkala joyda ham kerak.

Yechim

SELECT MIN(amount) AS reserve_price
FROM bids
WHERE status = 'qabul'
  AND amount > (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM bids WHERE status = 'qabul')

Takrorlar muammo emas: namunada 455 mln ni ikki kompaniya bergan, > ikkalasini ham chetga oladi va 480 mln qoladi. GROUP BY siz agregat doim bitta qator qaytaradi, ikkinchi narx bo'lmasa bu qatorda NULL turadi.

Tuzoqlar

Ichki so'rovda holatni unutish. Mega Build hujjatini to'liq topshirmagan, lekin uning 430 mln lik taklifi "eng arzon" bo'lib qoladi va javob 455 mln chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT MIN(amount) AS reserve_price
FROM bids
WHERE status = 'qabul'
  AND amount > (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM bids)

Saralab, ikkinchi qatorni olish ham xato. DISTINCT siz ikkinchi qator yana 455 mln. DISTINCT bilan esa ikkinchi narx bo'lmaganda natija bo'sh bo'ladi, masala esa NULL li bitta qatorni kutadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Saralash usulini skalyar subquery'ga o'rasangiz, bo'sh natija NULL ga aylanadi:

SELECT (
  SELECT DISTINCT amount
  FROM bids
  WHERE status = 'qabul'
  ORDER BY amount
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
) AS reserve_price
